question: interior-finishes-to-schedule
unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package on the 800 m2 NLA floor)

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package on the 800 m2 NLA floor)
band.basis: Sum of 13 distinct components: the six specified finishes (vinyl wall covering, feature paint, carpet tile, LVT, batten feature wall, MDF skirting), plasterboard substrate prep, latex smoothing to 100% of floor area, trims/transitions, surface protection, skip disposal, site measure/setout, and out-of-hours access loading. GST exclusive; excludes preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees per the brief. Midpoint $173,000 = $216/m2 over 800 m2 NLA, against the brief's $170,000/$213 per m2 — close in total but distributed differently (my smoothing-compound and skirting lines carry more, paint and LVT less). Main cost driver: loose-lay carpet tile, ~40% of the midpoint, on cited QV rows t2:r7/r8; the smoothing compound (~18%) is also fully cited. Proxy substitutions (Type II vinyl wall covering, LVT plank, MUF=MDF skirting, 60mm-centre batten count) and web/allowance items (~6–11% of the band) are why confidence is medium, not high. No allowance carries a main driver.

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one tenancy floor, 800 m2 NLA)
band.basis: Sum of the six measured finishes priced from cited QV Auckland rows (vinyl wall covering, acrylic paint, carpet tile, LVT plank, batten wall in three parts, MDF skirting) plus QV-cited latex smoothing compound over 730 m2 and QV-cited floor protection, plus minor allowances (wall substrate prep, trims/transitions, rubbish removal, site measure/setout, out-of-hours loading) which carry about 8% of the low total and 12% of the high. Carpet tile is the largest line at $64k-$73k. No web sources used - QV covered every trade in scope. GST exclusive, Auckland, no preliminaries, margin, design or consent fees. Midpoint $163,000 = $203/m2 over the 800 m2 NLA.

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one 800 m2 NLA tenancy floor)
band.basis: Component-by-component add of Auckland QV CostBuilder rows plus two labelled allowances, GST exclusive. Low $138,400 / high $179,700; midpoint $159,000 = $199/m2 over the 800 m2 NLA. Largest lines: carpet tile 640 m2 $64,000-72,960; latex smoothing compound 730 m2 $24,674-36,500; vinyl wall covering 220 m2 $14,520-15,840; MDF skirting 260 lm $7,930-9,516. Allowances (substrate prep, waste/skip/sundries, measure-setout-out-of-hours) total $6,380-15,200, i.e. 5-8% of the band, well under a third. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees, base-build plasterboard/partitions/framing, ceilings, joinery, glazing film, signage, floor levelling beyond smoothing compound, asbestos and existing-finish removal, and scaffolding/hoists/lift protection. QV rows are unreviewed. Widened for the LVT proxy and the batten-wall proxy, which are the two components where QV has no exact row.
